# Risk Entry — R__

Add to [SOW §9](../00-planning/SOW.md#9-risks) once filled in. The register is a living document —
PRD §19 holds R1–R10, SOW §9 holds R11 onward.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| ID | R__ |
| Raised | YYYY-MM-DD, by ___ |
| Risk | *If* ___ happens, *then* ___ — stated as a condition and a consequence, not a worry |
| Category | Schedule / Technical / Data / Hardware / External |
| Likelihood | Low / Medium / High |
| Impact | Low / Medium / High |
| Affects | Milestones, requirements, or owners at risk |
| Owner | One person |

## Review

| Date | Likelihood | Impact | Note |
|---|---|---|---|

Reviewed weekly (SOW §3.1). Close with the outcome recorded — a risk that never materialised is
still worth the note, because it tells the next reader the mitigation worked.

> A risk without a named trigger is a worry. A risk without a named owner is nobody's problem.
